author: Ryan George Extra Plus!
description:
Get exclusive videos & early access on my Patreon: http://patreon.com/RyanGeorge

Power Slap is a real regulated combat sport with a $750 million valuation where fighters get paid $2,000 and have an 80% chance of getting concussed, and I have some thoughts about that.

I don't know anything about sports but I do know that Power Slap, the sport where two people take turns slapping each other as hard as possible, is technically a thing that exists and is sanctioned by the United States government. I look at the official rules, the training process, why the TBS show nobody watched somehow turned into a billion views a month on social media, how Dana White is involved and making a lot of money, and what the people actually doing the slapping are getting paid for the privilege of an 80% concussion rate. I also have a replacement sport to propose. It involves cars.
